FROM CIRCUIT TO SIGNAL

Get connected in three steps.

  1. Check the wiring.

    Potentiometer outer terminals → 5V and GND. Wiper (middle terminal) → A0. Your diagram appears to use A0; confirm the pin on the physical board.

  2. Upload the sketch.

    Download the sketch, open it in Arduino IDE, select Arduino Uno and your port, then Upload. Close Serial Monitor afterward.

    ↓ Download Arduino sketch
  3. Connect your browser.

    Open this app in desktop Chrome or Edge over HTTPS or localhost. Connect the Uno using a USB data cable, click Connect Arduino, and select its serial port. Use 115200 baud for the included sketch.

This circuit reads a potentiometer’s position and voltage. It does not measure current or unknown resistance. Keep A0 within GND–5V. No readings are uploaded to a server.
